headline: Kuura Strand Footing Flips as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Since our last edition, the balance at Kuura Strand has turned: Wardens now hold three of that shore's six strongpoints to the Colonials' two, one post demolished, after fighting at Faden Point and Menneen logged five flag events in two hours. Linn of Mercy shows no sign of stilling — Outwich Ranch has absorbed sixteen changes in a day, the latest filed as this edition closed — though the eight-to-two Colonial footing stands. Nevish Line has flared around Tomb Father and Blackcoat Way, seventeen events in a day against an otherwise Warden-held map. Pari Peak, briefly stilled, is contested again at Pariah, the Colonial four-to-one margin intact. Weathered Expanse remains the war's great furnace: fifty-five events, Spirit Watch and Frostmarch busiest, with Wardens on four posts, Colonials on two, three in ruin. Stlican Shelf's Breaker Town stirs fitfully, while Marban Hollow's long seesaw and the Gutter's overnight melee have gone silent. Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle, and Olavis Wake grind on heavily without a flag moving. This is the war's 664th day.
